result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has overlapping subtitle text where the delivery time and delivery price labels are drawn on top of each other, making the metadata unreadable. A couple of smaller inconsistencies were also noted.

issues.description: Under 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar', the metadata line renders overlapping text: '25–35 min' and '€0 delivery' are drawn on top of one another ('25–3€0mdielivery'), making the line illegible.
issues.suggestion: Lay out the metadata items in a single flex row with proper spacing/separators (e.g. '25–35 min · €0 delivery · Ramen') instead of absolutely positioning them in the same spot.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) button styling is inconsistent between cards: the Tokumaru card uses a white circular background while the pizza card below uses a dark/transparent circle, reducing visual consistency and contrast.
issues.suggestion: Use one consistent favorite button treatment (background, icon color) across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: Cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel have inconsistent image treatment — the first (Green Bowl Poké) has a light background while the others are dark, which makes the row look unbalanced.
issues.suggestion: Normalize card image backgrounds or apply a consistent overlay so badges and thumbnails read uniformly.
